parts.name: Root
parts.description: The stateful container. Owns the committed { start, end } range value, the popover open state, and validation shared by both inputs and the calendar.

props.name: id
props.description: Id applied to the root element. Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled range value ({ start, end } of YYYY-MM-DD strings). Bindable. null represents the empty state.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial range value when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the committed range changes. The value stays null while the range is empty or incomplete.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables both inputs, the trigger, and the calendar.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Keeps the inputs focusable while preventing edits.

props.name: minValue
props.description: Earliest selectable date (YYYY-MM-DD) for both ends of the range.

props.name: maxValue
props.description: Latest selectable date (YYYY-MM-DD) for both ends of the range.

props.name: isDateUnavailable
props.description: Marks specific days as non-selectable in both the inputs and the calendar.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled popover open state. Bindable.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial popover open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the popover opens or closes; details include the reason and a cancel() escape hatch.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Whether confirming the range in the calendar closes the popover.

props.name: children
props.description: DateRangePicker parts to compose inside the root.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label for the range picker when no visible label is associated.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the range picker is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus should be visibly indicated (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-within
dataAttributes.description: Present while any part of the range picker contains focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present while a segment draft is not committable.

dataAttributes.name: data-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the calendar popover is open.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the range picker is readonly.

parts.name: Input
parts.description: One segmented date input for one end of the range. Render one with part="start" and one with part="end"; segments render with default styling when the children snippet is omitted.

props.name: part
props.description: Which end of the range this input edits: 'start' or 'end'.

props.name: id
props.description: Id applied to the input element so label[for] can target it. Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: name
props.description: Name submitted with the form for this end of the range.

props.name: children
props.description: Renders one segment per part; receives the segment descriptor. Defaults to plain segments.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label for this input, e.g. "Start date" or "End date".

props.name: aria-invalid
props.description: Overrides the invalid state exposed to assistive technology. Set automatically while the draft is not committable.

dataAttributes.name: data-date-range-picker-input
dataAttributes.description: Identifies a range picker input element.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the range picker is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus should be visibly indicated (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-within
dataAttributes.description: Present while a segment inside the input has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present while this input's segment draft is not committable.

dataAttributes.name: data-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the calendar popover is open.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the range picker is readonly.

parts.name: Segment
parts.description: One editable or literal segment of a range end (day, month, year, or separator). Supports typing and arrow-key stepping.

props.name: part
props.description: Which end of the range the segment belongs to; must match the enclosing input's part.

props.name: segment
props.description: The segment descriptor, as received from the Input children snippet.

dataAttributes.name: data-date-range-picker-segment
dataAttributes.description: Identifies a range picker segment element.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus should be visibly indicated (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the segment has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-placeholder
dataAttributes.description: Present while the segment shows its placeholder instead of a value.

dataAttributes.name: data-range-part
dataAttributes.description: Which end of the range the segment belongs to: 'start' or 'end'.

dataAttributes.name: data-type
dataAttributes.description: The segment type, e.g. 'day', 'month', 'year', or 'literal'.

parts.name: Trigger
parts.description: Button that opens and closes the range calendar popover.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the button, e.g. a calendar icon.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus should be visibly indicated (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the trigger has focus.

parts.name: Popover
parts.description: The floating panel that hosts the range calendar. Forwards Popover.Content props (placement, offset, shouldFlip, …); open state, trigger wiring, and id are controlled internally.

parts.name: Calendar
parts.description: The calendar surface inside the popover, fixed to range selection. Forwards Calendar.Root props such as visibleMonths, except those controlled by DateRangePicker.Root.

props.name: children
props.description: Calendar parts: triggers, heading, and grid.

parts.name: TriggerPrevious
parts.description: Button that pages the calendar to the previous month (or set of visible months).

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the button, e.g. an icon or label.

parts.name: Heading
parts.description: Displays the visible month heading, localized through the active locale.

parts.name: TriggerNext
parts.description: Button that pages the calendar to the next month (or set of visible months).

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the button, e.g. an icon or label.

parts.name: Grid
parts.description: Renders one visible month as an accessible grid named after the month heading.

props.name: children
props.description: Grid content, typically GridHeader and GridBody.

props.name: weekdayStyle
props.description: Width of the weekday header labels: 'narrow', 'short', or 'long'.

dataAttributes.name: data-calendar-grid
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the grid element.

dataAttributes.name: data-calendar-month
dataAttributes.description: The ISO month (YYYY-MM) rendered by this grid.

parts.name: GridHeader
parts.description: The weekday header row. Iterates the localized weekday labels and passes each to the children snippet.

props.name: children
props.description: Renders one header cell per weekday; receives the localized weekday label.

parts.name: HeaderCell
parts.description: One weekday label cell inside the grid header row.

props.name: children
props.description: The weekday label content.

parts.name: GridBody
parts.description: The day cells area. Iterates the visible days and passes each ISO date to the children snippet.

props.name: children
props.description: Renders one body cell per day; receives the ISO YYYY-MM-DD date.

dataAttributes.name: data-week
dataAttributes.description: Identifies a week row inside the grid body.

parts.name: BodyCell
parts.description: One focusable day cell. The first selection starts the range, hover previews it, and the second selection confirms it.

props.name: date
props.description: The ISO YYYY-MM-DD date this cell represents, as received from GridBody's snippet.

props.name: children
props.description: Custom cell content; receives the day number label. Defaults to the day number.

dataAttributes.name: data-date
dataAttributes.description: The ISO YYYY-MM-DD date of the cell.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the day cannot be selected (disabled, out of range, or unavailable).

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus should be visibly indicated (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the cell has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-hovered
dataAttributes.description: Present while the pointer is over the cell.

dataAttributes.name: data-in-range
dataAttributes.description: Present when the day falls inside the selected or previewed range.

dataAttributes.name: data-outside-month
dataAttributes.description: Present when the day belongs to an adjacent month.

dataAttributes.name: data-pressed
dataAttributes.description: Present while the cell is actively pressed.

dataAttributes.name: data-range-end
dataAttributes.description: Present on the last day of the selected or previewed range.

dataAttributes.name: data-range-start
dataAttributes.description: Present on the first day of the selected or previewed range.

dataAttributes.name: data-selected
dataAttributes.description: Present when the day is part of the committed range.

dataAttributes.name: data-today
dataAttributes.description: Present on today's date.

dataAttributes.name: data-unavailable
dataAttributes.description: Present when isDateUnavailable marks the day as unavailable.
